_comment: Canonical ingredient catalog. Densities are g/ml; grams_per_count is the weight of one typical item. These are physical facts that let recipe volumes, receipt weights and counted items reconcile - see core/units.py. package_qty/unit is the common retail size, used to round shopping quantities to something purchasable. is_staple marks things assumed always present, which are omitted from missing-ingredient lists unless explicitly marked out.
